label: Patient identifier
definition: Database-specific patient key (unique within a database)

label: Hospital admission identifier
definition: Unit of analysis; see docs/methods.md for what the unit is in each database
notes: VitalDB: surgical case; MOVER-SIS: surgical record; eICU: hospital stay; SICdb: case

label: Age at admission
definition: Years at hospital admission (or at operation for perioperative databases)
denominator: all admissions (missing counted)
notes: Top-coded / binned in several databases - see mapping notes

label: Age band
denominator: all admissions
notes: Bands inherited from Jinhua

label: Sex
definition: M / F; any other or unknown code is missing
denominator: all admissions
notes: Coded values resolved from each database dictionary, never guessed

label: Admission urgency
definition: emergency / elective / other as far as the source supports
denominator: all admissions
notes: Not recorded in several databases

label: Hospital length of stay
denominator: all admissions

label: Hospital LOS > 14 days
denominator: admissions with a recorded LOS
notes: Threshold from Jinhua; config/analysis_config.yml

label: In-hospital death
definition: Death during the hospital admission; ascertainment differs and is documented per database
denominator: all admissions (missing counted)
notes: Never merged with follow-up mortality

label: Death at last recorded follow-up
definition: Death at any recorded follow-up; mixes in-hospital and post-discharge deaths
denominator: all admissions
notes: Follow-up length differs by database

label: Discharge disposition (harmonised)
denominator: all admissions

label: ICU admission
definition: At least one ICU stay in the admission
denominator: all admissions
notes: By construction 1 in ICU-only databases

label: Number of ICU stays
denominator: ICU admissions

label: ICU length of stay
definition: Sum of ICU stay lengths within the admission (and per stay)
denominator: ICU admissions / stays

label: ICU LOS > 3 days
denominator: ICU admissions with LOS
notes: Threshold from Jinhua

label: Death during ICU stay
definition: Death inside an ICU stay (per stay)
denominator: ICU stays
notes: Derived differently by database; see meta notes

label: More than one ICU stay
denominator: ICU admissions
notes: Jinhua definition

label: Patients with >1 hospital admission
denominator: patients

label: Surgical admission
denominator: all admissions
notes: Jinhua reference counts ANY procedure record (74.4%); the harmonised flag counts named operations only

label: Native severity score
definition: Score supplied by the database (SAPS 3, APACHE IVa, ASA); never recalculated or pooled across scores
denominator: all admissions
notes: Not comparable across scores

label: Any coded diagnosis recorded
denominator: all admissions
notes: Denominator transparency for prevalence

label: Invasive mechanical ventilation
definition: Ascertainment differs by database; see support_definition in each adapter
denominator: ICU admissions (or all, per support_scope)

label: Renal replacement therapy
denominator: as above

label: Vasopressor / inotrope infusion
definition: Any record of a vasoactive infusion
denominator: as above
notes: Not in the Jinhua reference

label: Endotracheal intubation
denominator: as above

label: Tracheostomy
denominator: as above
